parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-08 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 218.1 | 18.02 | 18.02
2 | 105.0 | 1.05 | 19.07
3 | 60.0 | 1.04 | 20.11
4 | 317.3 | 0.57 | 20.68
5 | 1743.2 | 5.17 | 25.85
6 | 2231.3 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as QHAA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-08
Curve type: QHAA-type
Aquifer depth: 18.02 - 20.68 m
Recommendation: Target the low-resistivity interval between 18 and 21 meters to intercept the potential aquifer. Expect a transition to hard basement rock at approximately 20.7 meters.
